clauses.rule: GameState is immutable and engine transitions are pure and deterministic.
clauses.precondition: A state and command are supplied.
clauses.resultingBehavior: The same inputs produce the same fresh result; randomness is command data.
clauses.failureBehavior: No nondeterministic mutation is accepted.
clauses.invariant: The input snapshot remains unchanged.

clauses.rule: The state owns the existing card, zone, turn, mana, stack, choice, event, and derived records.
clauses.resultingBehavior: A transition returns a fresh state while allowing safe structural sharing.
clauses.failureBehavior: Input state branches are not mutated.
clauses.invariant: All existing state records remain represented.

clauses.rule: Physical identity and zone-change identity remain stable and exclusive.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Unknown commands fail deterministically and no physical card occupies two exclusive zones.
clauses.failureBehavior: Invalid identity or duplicate placement is rejected.
clauses.invariant: Object identity is derived from the existing identity values.

clauses.rule: Snapshots are the undo and redo boundary.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Restore backfills later fields without changing existing order.
clauses.failureBehavior: History navigation does not mutate the engine directly.
clauses.invariant: Card and event order remains stable across restore.

clauses.rule: Pinned Comprehensive Rules text is the deterministic rules authority.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Without executable replay, a clause remains guided or manual.
clauses.failureBehavior: No unsupported behavior is claimed automatic.

clauses.rule: GameCommand is the only engine write vocabulary.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Compiler output carries deterministic command intent and values.
clauses.failureBehavior: Compiler does not write GameState directly.
clauses.invariant: State writes pass through command application.

clauses.rule: Preconditions are validated before a command result is produced.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Rejected commands return stable errors and preserve input state.
clauses.failureBehavior: Warnings do not hide incomplete state.
clauses.invariant: Forced sandbox state remains explicit and deterministic.

clauses.rule: Command batches are ordered and atomic at the public transaction boundary.
clauses.resultingBehavior: One user-visible compound action creates one undo boundary.
clauses.failureBehavior: An incomplete batch does not publish a partial public result.
clauses.invariant: The store records one resulting snapshot per commit.

clauses.rule: Resolution and direct actions use the same command path.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Guided choices produce commands only after user input; unsupported compounds remain guided or manual.
clauses.failureBehavior: No guessed command sequence is emitted.
clauses.invariant: Clause boundaries remain visible.

clauses.rule: Shared and private zones retain their existing CR distinction.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Private records remain keyed by owner where supported.
clauses.failureBehavior: A zone is not silently reclassified by presentation.
clauses.invariant: Zone visibility follows the state model.

clauses.rule: Object movement creates the new zone-change identity boundary.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Owner, controller, token cleanup, and linked exile use the existing transition pipeline.
clauses.failureBehavior: No second transition path fabricates identity.
clauses.invariant: Transition identity is deterministic.

clauses.rule: Successful semantic changes produce immutable event records.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Event source, subject, cause, order, and reference remain available to presentation.
clauses.failureBehavior: Presentation cannot delay the state transition.
clauses.invariant: Cues consume events after commit.

clauses.rule: Last-known information comes from recorded transition data.
clauses.resultingBehavior: A later object with the same printed name cannot substitute for recorded LKI.
clauses.failureBehavior: No later-name inference is used.
clauses.invariant: LKI is tied to the transition record.

clauses.rule: Turn phases follow the existing ordered phase set and stack boundary.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Phase and turn transitions are command transactions only at legal boundaries.
clauses.failureBehavior: A transition is rejected while the stack boundary forbids it.
clauses.invariant: Phase order remains deterministic.

clauses.rule: Shared stack top, priority, pending triggers, and APNAP are deterministic.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Current player order, not UI iteration order, determines APNAP placement.
clauses.failureBehavior: Priority cannot be silently reordered by presentation.
clauses.invariant: The last announced shared-stack item is top.

clauses.rule: Turn entry uses the existing untap, reset, draw, cleanup, and mana operations.
clauses.resultingBehavior: The applicable player receives the current turn-entry operations; opening setup remains separate.
clauses.failureBehavior: No additional opening-hand ruling is inferred here.
clauses.invariant: The unresolved turn-draw acceptance conflict remains explicit.
clauses.needsDecision: CONFLICT-TURN-DRAW-001 must resolve the acceptance interpretation of turn-entry draw.

clauses.rule: Pending choices remain visible until resolved or cancelled.
clauses.resultingBehavior: A violating transition cannot proceed while a choice is unresolved.
clauses.failureBehavior: The transition remains blocked at the stack or priority boundary.
clauses.invariant: Pending choice state is not discarded by navigation.

clauses.rule: Supported mana cost components are parsed and payment is planned purely from a snapshot.
clauses.resultingBehavior: The plan accounts for existing colored, generic, hybrid, phyrexian, and variable components.
clauses.failureBehavior: Unsupported choice-bearing costs remain guided or manual.
clauses.invariant: Planning does not mutate the source snapshot.

clauses.rule: Accepted payment consumes only the selected resources.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Payment is deterministic and insufficient payment leaves no incomplete state.
clauses.failureBehavior: Warning or cancellation is returned for insufficient payment.
clauses.invariant: Forced sandbox payment remains explicit.

clauses.rule: Automatic tapping is limited to representable costs and no-stack mana abilities retain atomicity.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Choice-bearing or restricted costs remain guided/manual and supported abilities use one undo boundary.
clauses.failureBehavior: The planner does not guess a source choice.
clauses.invariant: No-stack mana transactions are atomic.

clauses.rule: Existing local identity, ordered players, records, and private zones are preserved.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Solo defaults remain unchanged.
clauses.failureBehavior: No player record is silently dropped.
clauses.invariant: The state boundary remains additive.

clauses.rule: Player-aware commands use explicit recipient or controller values where supported.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Life, poison, mana, draw, defeat advisory, and private-zone records address the intended player.
clauses.failureBehavior: The local player is not substituted silently.
clauses.invariant: Recipient identity is retained across the command path.

clauses.rule: APNAP uses state player order and setup is a deterministic transaction.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Unreachable players are not fabricated and cancel restores the canonical snapshot.
clauses.failureBehavior: Compiler and UI cannot invent an opponent.
clauses.invariant: Player order is the single APNAP order.

clauses.rule: Multiplayer is additive at the state boundary only.
clauses.resultingBehavior: No UI expansion, protocol change, or alternate identity spelling is introduced by this contract.
clauses.failureBehavior: Unsupported multiplayer surface remains outside the contract.
clauses.invariant: Solo/online boundary remains explicit.

clauses.rule: English oracleText is rules input and each recognized clause maps to a deterministic CR-referenced plan.
clauses.resultingBehavior: printedText remains display-only.
clauses.failureBehavior: Display text cannot change compilation eligibility.
clauses.invariant: Decision tier is declared per clause.

clauses.rule: auto requires executable replay; guided collects user choices; manual covers unsupported or ambiguous compounds.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Only the declared tier is exposed.
clauses.failureBehavior: Unsupported behavior is not labeled automatic.
clauses.invariant: Tier selection is deterministic.

clauses.rule: The compiler does not mutate state, invent targets, or turn warnings into resolution.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Supported leaves can execute without claiming unsupported siblings.
clauses.failureBehavior: Warning and unsupported boundaries remain visible.
clauses.invariant: Clause boundaries are preserved.

clauses.rule: Pinned CR and local Oracle fixtures are ordinary evidence; live Scryfall is periodic/online.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Ordinary acceptance remains offline.
clauses.failureBehavior: Network response cannot silently become ordinary evidence.
clauses.invariant: Online checks stay in the online lane.

clauses.rule: Solo Commander interactions use consistent affordances, visible state feedback, and reversible transactions.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Meaningful repeated operations retain a discoverable interaction grammar.
clauses.failureBehavior: A semantic operation is not hidden behind a one-off gesture.
clauses.invariant: Equivalent operations remain equivalent in intent.

clauses.rule: Ordinary actions are not scored and presentation follows successful semantic events.
clauses.resultingBehavior: GameState does not wait for animation, sound, or browser policy.
clauses.failureBehavior: A failed action does not emit success feedback.
clauses.invariant: Presentation remains downstream of commit.

clauses.rule: Every operation has a discoverable non-pointer alternative.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Context menu or equivalent remains available for drag, double-click, and compact-screen actions.
clauses.failureBehavior: Pointer-only operation is not the sole route.
clauses.invariant: Action intent remains reachable.

clauses.rule: Cards, zones, stack, choices, warnings, and semantic events use distinct visual roles.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Japanese labels use printedName fallback and established card-name treatment.
clauses.failureBehavior: Visual role is not inferred from incidental color alone.
clauses.invariant: Semantic roles remain distinguishable.

clauses.rule: Hierarchy, anchors, focus, counters, tapped state, targets, and decisions remain readable.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Critical state does not rely on color alone.
clauses.failureBehavior: Unresolved state is not visually erased.
clauses.invariant: Focus and semantic state remain visible.

clauses.rule: Design tokens have one semantic purpose and one documented owner.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Spacing, typography, color, radii, and motion reuse the existing design system.
clauses.failureBehavior: A new token without ownership is not accepted.
clauses.invariant: Token ownership remains explicit.

clauses.rule: Components render immutable store projections and do not mutate engine state directly.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Commands and store actions own transitions.
clauses.failureBehavior: A component-side direct engine mutation is out of contract.
clauses.invariant: The engine remains browser-independent.

clauses.rule: Equivalent semantic operations are exposed through appropriate game surfaces and browser-only concerns stay at the boundary.
clauses.resultingBehavior: The same operation is reachable from primary, dialog, sheet, and compact surfaces as applicable.
clauses.failureBehavior: Browser APIs do not enter src/engine.
clauses.invariant: Semantic operation identity is shared across layouts.

clauses.rule: Presentation may run after a successful commit and may omit cues under browser policy or reduced motion.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Command result does not change when presentation is omitted.
clauses.failureBehavior: Presentation cannot block state completion.
clauses.invariant: Event consumption is downstream of commit.

clauses.rule: Manifest and acceptance scenarios are the architecture traceability index.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Contract references remain machine-checkable.
clauses.failureBehavior: Unindexed architecture evidence is not considered complete.
clauses.invariant: Traceability is checked offline.

clauses.rule: The three contracted viewports keep active card, primary action, phase, stack, warnings, and undo discoverable.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Portrait, landscape, and desktop retain the active interaction surface.
clauses.failureBehavior: A fixed viewport does not hide the primary operation.
clauses.invariant: Viewport-specific layout does not change semantic operation.

clauses.rule: Dense zones may scroll or collapse but every operation remains reachable and dialog focus remains bounded.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Content is not hidden behind a fixed overlay.
clauses.failureBehavior: An active dialog cannot leak focus before resolution or cancellation.
clauses.invariant: Visible control or context action remains available.

clauses.rule: Browser verification is required for layout or interaction changes only.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Non-UI changes do not claim browser evidence.
clauses.failureBehavior: A UI-impacting change cannot close without the manual scenario.
clauses.invariant: Scope determines browser evidence.
clauses.manualProcedure: Run ACC-UI-RESP-001 in one stable browser session at 375x812, 812x375, and 1440x900; record console errors and reachability.

clauses.rule: Audio and motion present successful semantic events only.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Pointer, touch, keyboard, drag, menu, and focus alone do not emit cues.
clauses.failureBehavior: Unsuccessful actions do not produce success cues.
clauses.invariant: Cue policy is downstream of semantic event commit.

clauses.rule: BGM transport and semantic SFX are independent policies.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Theme, route, reduced-motion, and beat settings preserve their existing boundaries.
clauses.failureBehavior: Audibility controls do not rewrite saved preferences.
clauses.invariant: Light-theme silence and non-blocking presentation remain explicit.

clauses.rule: One bulk semantic action produces one event and one cue policy; commander cast is the ritual boundary.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Ordinary actions use ordinary semantic cues and state completes first.
clauses.failureBehavior: Presentation cannot split or delay the state transaction.
clauses.invariant: Event-to-cue cardinality remains deterministic.

clauses.rule: Human audibility and comfort are evaluated only in the AV manual scenario.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Mechanical AV checks remain deterministic and offline.
clauses.failureBehavior: Automation does not claim human comfort evidence.
clauses.invariant: Manual comfort scope stays explicit.
clauses.manualProcedure: Run ACC-AV-MANUAL-001 after an AV-impacting change and record audibility, timing, reduced motion, and comfort.

clauses.rule: Acceptance scenarios have stable IDs, contract references, fixtures, and an explicit oracle.
clauses.resultingBehavior: A scenario can be selected and rerun by ID.
clauses.failureBehavior: A scenario without an oracle or contract reference is invalid.
clauses.invariant: Scenario IDs remain globally unique.

clauses.rule: Manual, deferred, and periodic evidence remains separated from ordinary offline acceptance.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Live Scryfall and human comfort are not ordinary prerequisites.
clauses.failureBehavior: A periodic or deferred scenario cannot be represented as an ordinary pass.
clauses.invariant: Evidence lane and status are explicit.

clauses.rule: Acceptance reruns the complete scenario after a shared fixture or contract-domain change.
clauses.resultingBehavior: Release evidence compares final state and event output against the golden replay.
clauses.failureBehavior: A partial effect cannot be reported automatic or released.
clauses.invariant: Candidate freeze precedes the release check.
